name: Conventions — seeded scan, candidate cards, and the ReScan control
description: Walks the read surface of the Conventions extractor (L02 second half). From the sidebar's SKILLS LAB group, Conventions opens /repos/:repoId/conventions for the active repo; the page shows the seeded scan (server/src/db/seed-conventions.ts: one finished scan and the three mock candidates for acme/payments-api), each card with its rule, file:line evidence, confidence percentage and the Accept / Reject / Edit buttons, and — because a scan row exists — the header says ReScan rather than Run Scan. Nothing is clicked that writes: extraction needs a model and Accept/Reject/Edit are covered by CandidateCard.test.tsx, so this flow is read-only against seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (guaranteed by e2e-web.yml).

open Conventions from the SKILLS LAB group
a scan exists, so the control reads ReScan
